# Rachel Lynde

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015)</sub>
- **Role:** Housewife  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is a fat woman who walks with a waddle. She sits at her kitchen window keeping a sharp eye on everything that passes along the road.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031)_

## Personality

Mrs. Lynde is a notable, capable, and busybody housewife who prides herself on always speaking her mind without fear or favor. She is an outspoken, meddlesome gossip who keeps a vigilant watch over her neighbors and loves to create a sensation. Despite her sharp tongue, pessimism, and tendency to nag, she is a kind, good Christian woman, a devoted church worker, and an unwearied nurse when needed.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P24](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0024), [v1 c1 P30](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0030), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P1](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0001), [v1 c31 P4](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0004), [v1 c31 P7](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0007), [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)_

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde lived with her husband, Thomas Lynde, in Lynde's Hollow, where she kept watch over all passersby. When Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert decided to adopt a child, she openly voiced her doubts and disapproval. On her first visit to meet Anne Shirley, she criticized the orphan girl's physical appearance, sparking an outburst of anger from Anne; however, she forgave Anne after receiving a dramatic apology. She actively involved herself in community and church matters, running the Sewing Circle, aiding the Sunday school, and leading the Church Aid Society and Foreign Missions Auxiliary. Following the death of her husband, Thomas, and the realization that their mortgaged farm would have to be sold, Mrs. Rachel accepted Marilla Cuthbert's invitation to move into Green Gables rather than leave Avonlea. There, she set up her home in the former spare room and helped look after the twins, Davy and Dora.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P21](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0021), [v1 c1 P28](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0028), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c10 P29](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0029), [v1 c10 P35](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0035), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P21](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0021), [v2 c26 P27](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0027), [v2 c30 P0](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0000)_
